title: Account-driven feature funnel and priority scorer for enterprise asks
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
Create an operational funnel and automated priority scorer to normalize, aggregate, and produce an initial scoped package for enterprise feature requests handed to Product from Sales/CS. Current problem: requests arrive as disparate asks of varying quality and urgency, causing slow response times, missed SLAs for large accounts, and inconsistent scoping that burdens Eng and Solutions.

Goals (success metrics):
- Reduce initial triage time per enterprise ask from ~3 business days to <24 hours for Tier A accounts.
- Produce a 1–2 slide scoping packet + recommended priority score for 75% of incoming enterprise requests within SLAs.
- Increase Sales/CS satisfaction (CSAT) for intake responsiveness from baseline to +20% in Q2.
- Decrease engineering rework caused by unclear asks by 30% in first 3 months.

Scope (in):
- Normalize inbound asks from Salesforce cases, Intercom threads, and email templates used by AEs.
- Build a simple priority scoring rubric (account value, burst risk, regulatory/compliance requirement, SLO impact, engineering cost estimate).
- Generate an automated starter scoping packet: short problem statement, suggested solution approach (hosted/dedicated/private), minimum viable acceptance criteria, rough effort bucket, and suggested owner.
- Integration points: Salesforce case fields, a lightweight Google Slide template for scoping packet, and Console dashboard link.

Scope (out):
- Detailed engineering design, plans for Dedicated/Private deployments beyond initial recommendation, contract/legal negotiation.

Proposed approach:
1) Intake normalization: define a short canonical schema (persona, account tier, business outcome, data sensitivity, timeline, ownership). Work with Sales Ops to add/suggest fields to Salesforce Intake form and provide a one-click upload template for CS.
2) Priority scorer: weighted rubric implemented as a JSON checklist with human-adjustable weights. Initial algorithm will run in the Product intake sheet (no infra) and produce: High / Medium / Low and a numeric score 0–100.
3) Starter scoping packet: use a Google Slides template populated via doc merge (GSheet -> Slides) with links to relevant artifacts (POC PRD, pricing rubric).
4) Handoff flow: create a standard Slack channel pattern and a templated summary posted to #pm-intake for visibility and for Solutions to pick up.

Trade-offs considered:
- Build light, iterate vs. heavy automation: choose light to get SLAs quickly; automation (backend scoring service) deferred to later once rubric converges.
- Strict required fields vs. optional: require minimal critical fields (account tier, timeline, data sensitivity) and allow free text for the rest to avoid blocking CS.

Stakeholders:
- Sales/CS (primary requestors): Kate Morales, Diego Ruiz
- Sales Ops: Priya Singh
- Solutions Eng: Marco Li
- Eng (runtime/platform): Rahul Verma (dependency ENG-1842)
- Legal/Security (consult): Nina Ortega
- PM/Design: Asha Patel (lead), Liam Chen (assignee), Maya Thompson (design review)

Acceptance criteria:
- A documented intake schema exists and is approved by Sales Ops & Solutions.
- An initial priority scorer spreadsheet that ingests sample 40 historical requests and outputs priority labels that correlate with historical outcomes at >60% alignment.
- Google Slide template populated automatically for a pilot set of 10 incoming requests.
- A templated Slack handoff message and reporting dashboard link in Console.

Rollout plan:
- Week 0–2: Define schema with Sales Ops, collect 40 historical enterprise asks for calibration.
- Week 3: Implement scorer spreadsheet + scoring rubric and create Slide template. Pilot with 2 AE teams.
- Week 4–6: Iterate based on pilot feedback; add automation hooks for Salesforce case -> GSheet; document SOP and train CS.
- Post-pilot: evaluate automation requirements and hand off to Eng for a lightweight scoring service if needed.

Artifacts & Links:
- Intake schema draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/enterprise-intake-schema-draft
- Pilot sample dataset (anonymized): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/pilot-enterprise-asks
- Slide template: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/enterprise-scoping-template
- Slack playbook draft: https://app.confluence.company/pm/enterprise-intake-playbook

Open questions / risks:
- Will Sales Ops adopt additional required fields in Salesforce? (mitigation: keep required fields minimal and provide checkbox macros for AE workflows)
- How often will we need to adjust weights in the priority rubric? (mitigation: schedule monthly review for Q2)
- Need for security/legal review for any items flagged as regulated — define clear triage path to Nina.

Next steps (owner + due):
- Asha to finalize schema and sample dataset by 2026-02-22.
- Liam to implement initial scorer spreadsheet and populate with 40 historic samples by 2026-02-28.
- Sales Ops (Priya) to provision sample AE teams for pilot by 2026-03-04.
